decisions.title: Type the Letter, Keep the Same Mailbox
decisions.description: s15 already moves bytes through an in-process Mailbox. This chapter wraps those bytes in an Envelope (kind, id, triggerTurn) instead of inventing a new bus. request maps to Codex NEW_TASK/followup; response maps to harness-posted FINAL_ANSWER; send_message/MESSAGE stays the untyped s15 path.
decisions.alternatives: A separate JSON-RPC or A2A channel would imply cross-process agents. Codex collaboration is intra-session mail, not Agent Cards over HTTP.

zh.title: 给信分型，不换信箱
zh.description: s15 已经用进程内 Mailbox 传字节。本章只是把字节包进 Envelope（kind、id、triggerTurn），不另起一条总线。request 对应 Codex NEW_TASK/followup；response 对应 harness 投的 FINAL_ANSWER；send_message/MESSAGE 仍是 s15 那条不分型的路。

decisions.title: replyTo Is a Teaching Ledger
decisions.description: Root keeps a pending Map keyed by request id and matches responses by replyTo. Codex addresses by AgentPath and posts completion one hop to the parent — it does not correlate N in-flight requests. The ledger is the same kind of teaching step-up as s12's claim_task on top of update_plan.
decisions.alternatives: Matching the latest reply works in a single-flight demo and breaks as soon as two requests overlap. Guessing from natural-language tone is worse.

zh.title: replyTo 是教学账本
zh.description: root 用请求 id 做 pending Map，靠 replyTo 配对。Codex 按 AgentPath 寻址，完成通知一跳给父——并不对 N 路 in-flight 请求。这本账和 s12 在 update_plan 上加 claim_task 是同一类教学加强。

decisions.title: Broadcast Is Extra; Unknown Ids Are Dropped
decisions.description: Kickoff and stand-down fan out to every registered mailbox with no reply. Codex has no broadcast kind (completion is one hop to the parent). A response whose replyTo is not on the ledger is ignored, so a ghost or duplicate cannot tick the wrong row.
decisions.alternatives: Per-recipient request for announcements doubles traffic and invents fake replies. Accepting unknown ids would corrupt the ledger under concurrency.

zh.title: 广播是教学加的；未知 id 丢掉
zh.description: 开工/收工扇出到每个已注册邮箱，不回执。Codex 没有 broadcast kind（完成通知一跳给父）。replyTo 不在账本上的响应直接忽略，幽灵或重复不能勾错行。
